description: This file manages Discord permissions, including fetching and interpreting guild, channel, and user permission bits, and handling permission overwrites for channels.

methods.name: addPermissionBits
methods.description: Adds permission bits to a base permission set.

methods.name: removePermissionBits
methods.description: Removes permission bits from a base permission set.

methods.name: bitfieldToPermissions
methods.description: Converts a permission bitfield into an array of permission names.

methods.name: hasAdministrator
methods.description: Checks if the permission bitfield includes administrator rights.

methods.name: hasPermissionBit
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission bit is set in the bitfield.

methods.name: isThreadChannelType
methods.description: Determines if a channel type is a thread type.

methods.name: fetchBotUserId
methods.description: Fetches the bot's user ID via the Discord API.

methods.name: fetchMemberGuildPermissionsDiscord
methods.description: Fetches guild-level permissions for a user, excluding channel-specific overwrites.

methods.name: hasGuildPermissionsDiscord
methods.description: Checks if a user has specific guild permissions based on a predicate.

methods.name: hasAnyGuildPermissionDiscord
methods.description: Checks if a user has any of the specified permissions.

methods.name: hasAllGuildPermissionsDiscord
methods.description: Checks if a user has all of the specified permissions.

methods.name: fetchChannelPermissionsDiscord
methods.description: Fetches and computes the effective permissions for a channel, considering overwrites.
